description: This file defines a Flutter widget called LocationSearchSheet, which provides a UI component allowing users to search and select a destination location via a text input and predefined suggestions. It is a bottom sheet that overlays on the app to facilitate location search functionality.

classes.name: LocationSearchSheet
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a location search bottom sheet with suggestions and text input.

classes.name: _LocationSearchSheetState
classes.description: State class managing the search input, suggestions filtering, and user interaction handling for the LocationSearchSheet.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the LocationSearchSheet widget.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the text editing controller when the widget is removed.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, including search input and suggestions list.

methods.name: _onSearchChanged
methods.description: Updates the filtered suggestions list based on the user's search query.

methods.name: _onSearchSubmitted
methods.description: Handles the event when the user submits their search query, triggering the destination selection.
